standard.summary: H3 冻结主干矩阵乘的 INT8 执行模式。oracle（默认）是速度与数值的平衡点；w8a16 可再省约 1.55GB reserved 显存，但实测慢约 46%。
standard.effect: 决定 INT8 权重与激活的组合方式与 kernel 选择；取值在加载时归一化（连字符转下划线），非法值报错。LoRA 参数不受影响（见 h3_preserve_lora_master_dtype）。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 oracle；显存被 reserved 卡死、宁可慢一半也要挤出 1.5GB 时切 w8a16。
standard.avoidWhen: 追求吞吐时不要选 w8a16；对数值敏感的对照实验建议固定一种模式全程使用。

standard_en.summary: The INT8 execution mode for the frozen H3 backbone's matrix multiplications. oracle (the default) is the balance point between speed and numerics; w8a16 frees roughly another 1.55GB of reserved VRAM but measures about 46% slower.
standard_en.effect: It decides how INT8 weights and activations combine and which kernel is chosen; the value is normalised at load (hyphens to underscores) and an invalid one errors. LoRA parameters are unaffected (see h3_preserve_lora_master_dtype).
standard_en.whenToUse: oracle by default; switch to w8a16 when reserved VRAM is what pins you and you would rather be half as fast than short 1.5GB.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not choose w8a16 when chasing throughput, and for numerically sensitive comparisons keep one mode for the whole experiment.

advanced.principle: INT8 GEMM 把冻结主干的权重（W8）与可选的激活（A8/A16）量化后用整数核计算：W8A8 快但激活量化误差大，W8A16 数值好且省激活显存但当前 kernel 慢；oracle 模式按层特征选择安全的组合。
advanced.intervention: minimax_h3/loader.py：normalize_int8_gemm_mode(config.h3_int8_gemm_mode) 后传入模型构建；configs_h3.py：取值集合校验。
advanced.expectedImpact: oracle：接近 BF16 的质量与最优速度；w8a16：-1.55GB reserved、约 -46% 吞吐（本机实测）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 量化 GEMM 的数值特征与 BF16 不同，切换模式后 loss 曲线不可直接对比。

advanced_en.principle: INT8 GEMM quantizes the frozen backbone's weights (W8) and optionally activations (A8/A16) for integer-kernel compute: W8A8 is fast but has large activation-quantization error; W8A16 has good numerics and saves activation VRAM but the current kernel is slow; oracle picks safe combinations per layer characteristics.
advanced_en.intervention: minimax_h3/loader.py: normalize_int8_gemm_mode(config.h3_int8_gemm_mode) then passed into model construction; configs_h3.py: value-set validation.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: oracle: near-BF16 quality with the best speed; w8a16: -1.55GB reserved, roughly -46% throughput (measured locally).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Quantized GEMM's numerical character differs from BF16 — loss curves are not directly comparable across modes.
